summary: DeepSeek released an experimental multimodal variant of its V4-Flash model, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, adding vision input support and a new Files API for image uploads.

practices.reason: The model adds a new modality and claims improved multimodal agent performance, but the gain is described qualitatively against the lab's own benchmark rather than with a stated figure.
practices.quote: On multimodal agent benchmarks, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp makes a major leap over V4-Flash, bringing multimodal agent performance close to Opus-4.8.

practices.reason: A new model id, multimodal input format, and a Files API for image handling are concrete interface additions a team would need to wire up to use the model.
practices.quote: Files API is now live 📁 ​ 🔹 Free to use 🔹 Upload an image once, then reference it by file_id to save request bandwidth

practices.reason: The claimed capability leap is measured on the lab's own internal multimodal agent benchmarks, not a transferable or named methodology.
practices.quote: On multimodal agent benchmarks, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp makes a major leap over V4-Flash
